With the job-node scenario's 0.3 s start gap, the two rounds then overlapped and b70's ended 'lease none' (k16 held, one receipt confirmed); the scenario now starts k16 once b70's round is over.

Both complete runs were in a fresh directory from the documented commands; no Node, NBB, JVM, hosted compiler, C compiler or C loader runs.
